name: slipper-in-the-woods
description: A persistent 4D spatial storytelling engine built with React, R3F, Rapier, Vite, Web Workers, Zustand, and Cloudflare Pages.

scripts.dev:pages: npm run build && wrangler pages dev dist --compatibility-date=2026-04-30
scripts.prebuild: npm run final:world && npm run content:qa && npm run world:compile
scripts.repair:world:legacy: node scripts/apply-world-object-optimisations.mjs && node scripts/enforce-single-master-lantern.mjs && node scripts/optimise-world-rendering.mjs && node scripts/upgrade-ground-environment.mjs && node scripts/upgrade-ground-surface.mjs && node scripts/optimise-visual-cleanup.mjs && node scripts/upgrade-player-collision.mjs && node scripts/final-world-polish.mjs && node scripts/harden-4d-world.mjs && node scripts/rebuild-smooth-4d-world.mjs && node scripts/fix-smooth-world-markers.mjs && node scripts/fix-terrain-worker-type-narrowing.mjs
scripts.build: npm run typecheck:functions && tsc -b && vite --config vite.config.ts build
scripts.check: npm run validate && npm run lint && npm run content:qa && npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:functions && npm run test:unit && npm run test:security && npm run build && npm run wrangler:check
scripts.wrangler:check: wrangler pages functions build functions --outdir .wrangler/functions-build --project-directory . --build-output-directory dist --compatibility-date=2026-04-30
scripts.deploy:pages: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name slipper-in-the-woods
scripts.assets:compress:wolf: gltf-transform optimize public/models/source/wolf.glb public/models/wolf.glb --compress draco --texture-compress ktx2 --texture-size 1024
scripts.assets:compress:phantom: gltf-transform optimize public/models/source/phantom.glb public/models/phantom.glb --compress draco --texture-compress ktx2 --texture-size 1024
